service.description: Scan component skills directories, upsert AgentSkillRegister rows, and optionally refresh the skill DataFeed index.
Resolve the best authorized AgentSkill candidate for a natural-language business request.
Search skill documents through the standard DataDocument/OpenSearch path and filter the result by artifact authorization.

actions.script:
import org.moqui.agent.AgentToolSupport
int effectiveLimit = Math.max(1, (limit ?: 20) as Integer) String query = queryText ?: '*' def searchResult = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.search.SearchServices.search#DataDocuments') .parameters([ indexName: indexName, documentType: 'AgentSkillDocument', queryString: query, pageSize: effectiveLimit, pageIndex: 0, clusterName: clusterName, flattenDocument: true ]).call() List<Map> docs = (searchResult?.documentList instanceof List) ? (List<Map>) searchResult.documentList : [] skillList = [] docs.each { Map doc -> if (domainName && (doc.domainName ?: '') != domainName) return if (skillTypeEnumId && (doc.skillTypeEnumId ?: '') != skillTypeEnumId) return if (AgentToolSupport.checkArtifactAccess(ec, doc.artifactTypeEnumId as String ?: 'AT_AGENT_SKILL', 'AUTHZA_VIEW', doc.artifactName as String ?: '')) { skillList << doc } } skillCount = skillList.size()

service.description: Index the AgentSkillDocument DataFeed with the standard Moqui SearchServices path.
